Text-to-SQL agents should be evaluated on their ability to discover schema information independently rather than relying on pre-provided database schemas.

Schemablind operates without a pre-provided schema. It interacts with unknown databases using four specific verbs: list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, and run_sql_readonly.

Batching describe_table calls reduced turns from 9.0 to 5.6 and tokens from 13,024 to 8,576. On the held-out half, the agent costs 11,816 tokens over 6.6 turns.

The daily token cap is the primary factor blocking test runs, rather than monetary costs. The free tier daily cap is 200k tokens per model. Runs that hit a daily refusal are abandoned rather than scored to prevent inaccurate performance reporting.

Execution accuracy is measured by comparing the rows returned by the agent against a reference query. Tuning a prompt based on failed questions and then scoring it on those same questions results in a metric fitted to its own answer key.

40% of the question set is held back from the model to prevent overfitting.

bodies.thread:
A wrong query can be right by accident. Execution accuracy is measured by comparing the rows returned by the agent against those returned by a reference query on the same database.

The BIRD benchmark uses set comparison that ignores duplicates by default. This allows queries that are technically incorrect to pass as accurate.

Tuning a prompt based on failed questions and then scoring it on those same questions results in a metric fitted to its own answer key.

To prevent overfitting, 40% of the question set is held back from the model. The selection of this set is determined by a hash of the question text rather than editable fields.

The daily token cap is the primary factor blocking test runs, rather than monetary costs. A run that hits the daily token cap is abandoned rather than scored.

Runs that hit a daily refusal are abandoned rather than scored to prevent inaccurate performance reporting.

Text-to-SQL agents must be evaluated on their ability to discover schema information independently rather than relying on pre-provided database schemas.
